description: This repo's overrides, merged on top of the shared preset (renovate/default.json) that renovate.yml passes as global config. See docs/renovate.md#this-repos-renovatejson.

customManagers.description: The golangci-lint JSON schema that the ci-go-* lint jobs verify the config against (SCHEMA_URL) must be the one of the golangci-lint version the golangci-lint-action step installs (with.version). Renovate's github-actions manager bumps that version but can't see the URL, so this tracks it as the same dependency (depName and packageName golangci/golangci-lint, github-releases) and both land in the same PR at the same version.
